text: Are you guys alright?! Hold on, we're coming!!
You guys are the troops from the garrison in\nEl Scaro, right? Do you know where Balft is?
Oh! Mr. Balft and our commander went first.\nWe're staying here to fight and prevent the\nmonsters from going after them!
Okay, so they went first. Thanks!\nYou guys can continue with the fight!
That's how we make our entrance!\nCool right?!
Thank you for backing us up...But wait?!\nAren't you the adventurer and Miss Pelulu?!\nAren't you supposed to be heading to Eldenbaum?!
Yeah, but the king told us to get rid of the\nmonsters attacking El Scaro...Besides...
Triet wants us to stop this guy, so we came.
I know many things have happened and you've lost\nmany things...But you can't just give up on your\nlife and act recklessly!
So just leave this place to me and the adventurer\nand take the commander with you to El Scaro\nfirst...
How dare you Balft!! Hmm, where'd he go?
Hey, why are you just watching!!
Anyway, it's no joke this time.\nI think he's really upset...
But! Since we promised Triet we'd bring him home\nsafe and sound, we should keep our promise!\nI won't let him get away!!
Please go first. I also noticed that\nMr. Balft seems somewhat depressed.\nIt seems like he's seeking a place to die...
I'm also begging you to take him home safely...\nOh, me? I'll be fine.\nI'll just go back to where the troops are!
An intense clashing sound can be heard\nechoing from beyond the passage.\nSeems like there's a battle going on...
Oh no! If he keeps going like that they'll fall\ntogether!!
Hey, Balft!\nYou're gonna fall if you keep going like that!!\nStop! I said stopppp!!
